name: Sina Bernini Bristol
positioning: Contemporary-Baroque hotel on Piazza Barberini in the heart of Baroque Rome, a few steps from the Spanish Steps and the Trevi Fountain
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the Spanish Steps and the Trevi Fountain
Guests who like Baroque elegance in a contemporary style
Travelers curious about Rome's ancient art and history

facts.text: The hotel stands on Piazza Barberini in Rome.
The hotel is located in the heart of Baroque Rome.
Villa Borghese is listed among the hotel's nearby sights.
The hotel has been welcoming guests in Rome for 150 years.
The hotel has a Contemporary-Baroque style.
The hotel offers a Barberini Penthouse Suite.
Room categories include a Tribute Suite with a view over the piazza.
The hotel's restaurant is on the 8th floor.
The restaurant holds Due cappelli in the Guida Espresso 2025.
The hotel offers Roman experiences that reveal an authentic side of Rome.
The hotel has obtained DCA sustainability certification.
The hotel's meeting spaces have state-of-the-art technology.

highlights.text: Piazza Barberini is a few steps from the Spanish Steps and the Trevi Fountain.
The rooms revive the elegance of the Baroque era in a contemporary style.
The hotel joins the Art Out of the Museum initiative, helping restore and present ancient Roman artifacts.
The suites include a Trevi Suite with a terrace.
The Wellness Area has a humid area with a sauna and a chromotherapy steam room.

considerations.text: The hotel is on Piazza Barberini, not on the Spanish Steps or at the Trevi Fountain; both are a few steps away.
WhataHotel notes a tourist-heavy location with constant crowds.
